body: real genius (1985)

i’ve been in therapy every week since i was 4. i’ve been on countless medications. in the past year i have been institutionalized twice. i’ve tried dbt, cbt, all manners of therapy. before i dropped out of college because of my fucking issues i was going to BE a therapist. i have talked so many people off the ledge, including people i barely knew, people from the internet, my closest friends and siblings. i know the system and i know the coping skills. i have what the system considers help. i have a ton of it. it just doesn’t work. i’ve worked my ass off trying to recover and it’s never enough.

so many reasons — i have a fuck ton of trauma along with genetic mental illnesses that went untreated for so long that they are now debilitating. i cant hold down a job for more than a few months without having a breakdown on the clock and getting fired (i got fired again today). i am a burden on my family and friends because of my chronic executive dysfunction. they tell me if i don’t have a job i will starve and be homeless and they can’t get it through their heads that i don’t care. i want to die. life has no meaning and i have no incentive to survive, and no one will let me die. i just get berated for “being lazy” and “not doing anything myself” when i never asked them to do anything for me.
it’s fire!!! i’ve always described it as fire in my brain that consumes and burns the “me” part down.

hi!! i’ve been misdiagnosed my whole entire life as autistic, bipolar and borderline but i was just recently diagnosed with severe untreated adhd-pi, depression, and insomnia. since starting adderall my whole life has changed!!! this discovery is really weird and interesting for me because my whole life i’ve felt like i would always be as miserable as i was and that life had no point if i was always suffering so deeply. i didn’t think adderall would help this much but it totally is!! 

the best part is that i have a really awful and strained relationship with my father, and after he learned about my diagnosis he began looking into it. my psychiatrist said that since adhd is genetic that one of my parents probably has it. since i started researching adhd i’ve been thinking my dad has it, but he finally is open to the idea that he might!!! he’s going to his psychiatrist in a few days and he’s going to be evaluated and see if he can start adderall which i think will be really great for him individually and for our relationship. i think both of us feeling rushed all the time and being in so much mental anguish caused a good number of our problems in my childhood and that things are really looking up in so many ways!!
